**Meet Rowbase: Turn Your Spreadsheets Into APIs in Seconds!**

We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Rowbase, the tool that turns your CSV files into live, queryable APIs with zero setup! Launched on March 4, 2026, Rowbase is here to make your data work harder for you.

Upload a file, and Rowbase instantly generates a clean, documented API endpoint your apps can start using right away. It supports five file formats, so your existing data slots right in.

Want to get started? The free tier includes 1,000 requests per day, so you can build, test, and ship without spending a dime!

Rowbase has already been shaped by 212 incredible beta users, whose feedback helped us polish every feature. Thank you for believing in us from day one!

Head to rowbase.dev today, drop in your first CSV, and watch your data come alive. We can't wait to see what you build!
